summary: Reconcile an external operation after a timeout, reset or missing response before deciding whether any retry is safe.
triggers: request timeout connection reset uncertain receipt
push send publish may have completed
exclusions: The service returned a definitive validation error before attempting the operation.
A verified receipt already shows the exact requested outcome.
assumptions: The operation has a service-side receipt, state or history that can be inspected with an existing tool.
A timeout, connection reset or interrupted tool result does not distinguish failure from a lost success response.
No credential is read merely to answer a recovery question.
